triples.quote: So you positively declare that you are not guilty of the death of your father, Fyodor Pavlovitch?

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Gentlemen, she is my betrothed!” he said ecstatically and reverently, looking round at them all.

triples.quote: Grusha, my life, my blood, my holy one!” Mitya fell on his knees beside her and held her tight in his arms.

triples.subject: Grigory Vassilyevitch
triples.quote: That old man used to carry me in his arms, gentlemen. He used to wash me in the tub when I was a baby three years old, abandoned by every one, he was like a father to me!...

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: I believe I’ve had the honor and pleasure of meeting you, Nikolay Parfenovitch, at my kinsman Miüsov’s.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: And the very same day, in the evening I beat my father. I nearly killed him, and I swore I’d come again and kill him, before witnesses....

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: I am guilty of the blood of another old man but not of my father’s. And I weep for it! I killed, I killed the old man and knocked him down....

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: So you positively declare that you are not guilty of the death of your father, Fyodor Pavlovitch?

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: But, gentlemen, that woman is the queen of my heart. Oh, let me tell you that.

triples.subject: Agrafena Alexandrovna
triples.quote: Did you hear her cry, ‘I’ll go to death with you’? And what have I, a penniless beggar, done for her? Why such love for me?

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: I’m struck all of a heap myself, for who can have murdered him, if not I? That’s what it comes to, isn’t it?
